items.passage: Maria practiced the piano every day for a year. ______ she was able to play the entire sonata at the spring recital.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе предложение — следствие ежедневных занятий: As a result (A). However задаёт противопоставление, которого нет; For example и Instead не подходят — это не пример и не замена.

items.passage: Most cats dislike water. ______ the Turkish Van breed is known for enjoying swimming.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Порода, любящая плавать, — исключение из общего правила: нужен контраст, However (D). Therefore и Similarly предполагают следствие или сходство; In addition — просто добавление.

items.passage: The recipe calls for several kinds of fruit. ______ it uses apples, pears, and blueberries.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе предложение уточняет, какие именно фрукты: Specifically (B). However и Nevertheless — противопоставление; Therefore — следствие, а не уточнение.

items.passage: First, the students collected water samples from the pond. ______ they tested each sample for pollutants in the lab.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Последовательность действий после «First»: Then (B). However и In contrast противопоставляют; For instance вводит пример.

items.passage: The museum is free on Sundays. ______ it is usually very crowded on that day.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Бесплатный вход — причина толпы: Consequently (D). Nevertheless и In contrast означают противоречие; For example не вводит пример.

items.passage: Bicycles produce no exhaust. ______ they take up much less space on the road than cars do.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе — ещё одно преимущество велосипеда: In addition (A). However — противопоставление; For example — пример (а это новое преимущество); Therefore — меньше места не следует из отсутствия выхлопа.

items.passage: Sam wanted to spend the weekend at the beach. ______ it rained all weekend, so he stayed home.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Дождь помешал планам: Unfortunately вводит неприятный поворот (C). Similarly и For example не подходят; дождь не следствие желания Сэма (Therefore).

items.passage: Many birds migrate south for the winter. Robins in some areas, ______ stay all year if they can find enough food.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Зимующие малиновки — исключение из правила о миграции: however (A). Therefore и likewise предполагают следствие или сходство; for example — пример мигрирующих птиц, а малиновки как раз не мигрируют.

items.passage: The team lost its first three games. ______ it won the next ten in a row and reached the finals.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Победы после поражений — контраст: However (B). Similarly и For instance не отражают поворот; Therefore — поражения не причина побед.

items.passage: Plants need sunlight to make food. ______ a plant kept in a dark closet will eventually die.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Вывод из первого предложения: без света нет пищи, значит растение погибнет — Therefore (B). However — противоречие; Meanwhile — одновременность; Similarly — сходство.

items.passage: Some students prefer to study in silence. ______ others like to listen to quiet music while they work.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Две противоположные привычки: In contrast (A). As a result и Thus — следствие; For example — пример тех, кто учится в тишине, а речь о других.

items.passage: The village had no electricity until 1985. ______ residents used oil lamps and wood stoves.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Лампы и печи использовали до 1985 года: Before then (A). Afterward указывает на время после электрификации — противоречие; In addition и Similarly не задают нужного времени.

items.passage: The trail is steep and rocky. ______ hikers should wear sturdy boots.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Совет следует из описания тропы: Therefore (C). However и In contrast противопоставляют; For example — не пример крутой тропы.

items.passage: Lena wrote her essay in one evening. Her friend Tom, ______ spent two weeks revising his.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Один вечер против двух недель — контраст: by contrast (A). As a result и therefore — привычки Лены не причина привычек Тома; for example не подходит.

items.passage: The store sells many kinds of fresh vegetables. ______ it sells carrots, spinach, and peppers grown on local farms.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Морковь, шпинат и перец — примеры овощей: For instance (D). However и Nevertheless — противопоставление; Instead — замена.

items.passage: For centuries, sailors relied on the stars to find their way at sea. ______ the invention of the magnetic compass gave navigators a tool they could use even on cloudy nights.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Компас — следующий этап во времени после навигации по звёздам: Later (D). Similarly — сходство, но компас отличается; For example — компас не пример навигации по звёздам; Consequently — опора на звёзды не причина изобретения.

items.passage: Electric cars produce no tailpipe emissions. ______ the electricity used to charge them may come from power plants that burn coal, so their overall environmental impact depends on the local energy supply.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Оговорка, ограничивающая преимущество: However (C). Therefore — уголь не следует из отсутствия выхлопа; For example и Likewise не вводят ограничение.

items.passage: The novelist wrote her first three books in Spanish. ______ she wrote her fourth in English, the language of the country where she had lived for a decade.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Четвёртая книга на другом языке — контраст: By contrast (D). Similarly противоречит смене языка; For instance и In other words — пример или перефразирование, которых нет.

items.passage: Octopuses have about 500 million neurons. ______ about two-thirds of these neurons are located in the animal's arms rather than in its brain.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе предложение добавляет неожиданную подробность о тех же нейронах: Remarkably (B). Therefore — расположение не следует из числа; In contrast и Similarly предполагают сравнение с чем-то другим.

items.passage: The city's population doubled between 1990 and 2010. ______ the number of public schools stayed almost the same, leading to crowded classrooms.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Население выросло, а школ не прибавилось — контраст: However (A). Therefore — рост населения не причина неизменного числа школ; Similarly — противоположно; For example не подходит.

items.passage: Ancient Egyptians used papyrus, a plant that grew along the Nile, to make paper. ______ they wove its stems into baskets, mats, and even small boats.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Ещё одно применение папируса: In addition (C). In contrast и Nevertheless противопоставляют; Consequently — плетение корзин не следует из изготовления бумаги.

items.passage: Some economists argue that raising the minimum wage reduces employment. ______ several recent studies have found little or no effect on the number of jobs.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Исследования противоречат мнению экономистов: However (A). Therefore, Similarly и Furthermore предполагают согласие или продолжение мысли.

items.passage: The ancient city of Petra was carved directly into sandstone cliffs. ______ many of its buildings have survived for more than two thousand years.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Высеченные в скале здания долговечны — следствие: As a result (A). Nevertheless предполагает противоречие; Similarly и For instance не отражают причинную связь.

items.passage: Most volcanoes form where tectonic plates meet. Hawaii's volcanoes, ______ sit in the middle of the Pacific Plate, far from any plate boundary.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Гавайские вулканы — исключение: however (B). Therefore и similarly предполагают следствие или сходство; for example сделал бы их примером вулканов на границах плит, что неверно.

items.passage: To reduce food waste, the school began weighing the leftovers from each lunch period. ______ it started offering smaller portions to students who requested them.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Вторая мера в той же кампании: Additionally (C). However и In contrast противопоставляют; Instead означал бы, что взвешивание прекратили.

items.passage: The first telephones required an operator to connect each call by hand. ______ automatic switching systems allowed callers to dial numbers themselves.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Автоматика появилась позже — развитие во времени: Eventually (A). Similarly — противоположно; For example не подходит; Therefore — ручное соединение не причина автоматики само по себе.

items.passage: Bamboo can grow almost a meter in a single day. ______ it is one of the fastest-growing plants on Earth.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Вывод из скорости роста: Thus (C). However — противоречие; For example — вывод не является примером; Instead — замена.

items.passage: Researchers expected that students who studied with music would perform worse on the test. ______ those students scored about the same as students who studied in silence.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Результат не совпал с ожиданием: Surprisingly (D). Therefore означало бы, что результат следует из ожидания; Similarly и For instance не отражают неожиданность.

items.passage: Coffee plants grow best at high elevations in tropical regions. ______ much of the world's coffee comes from mountainous areas of Ethiopia, Colombia, and Vietnam.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Горные районы — следствие условий, нужных кофе: Accordingly («соответственно») (C). However и Nonetheless противопоставляют; Instead — замена.

items.passage: The library's collection was damaged in a flood in 2019. ______ volunteers spent months drying and repairing thousands of books.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Ремонт книг — после наводнения: Afterward (A). Previously указывает на время до; Similarly и In contrast не задают последовательность.

items.passage: Many people assume that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye. ______ astronauts have reported that the wall, though long, is too narrow to see from orbit without aid.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Слова астронавтов опровергают распространённое мнение: In reality (C). Consequently и For this reason предполагают следствие из ошибочного мнения; Likewise — сходство.

items.passage: The author's first novel was praised for its intricate plot. Her second, ______ was criticized as confusing, even by readers who had admired her debut.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Похвала первому и критика второму — контраст: by contrast (A). Consequently — похвала не причина критики; likewise — противоположно; in other words — не перефразирование.

items.passage: Glass appears solid, and it behaves like a solid in everyday life. ______ its atoms are not arranged in the orderly, repeating pattern found in crystals such as quartz.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Переход от бытового впечатления к строению с противопоставлением: At the atomic level, however (D). As a result — беспорядок атомов не следует из твёрдости; For example и Similarly не передают контраст.

items.passage: Early critics dismissed photography as a mechanical process that required no artistic skill. ______ by the early twentieth century, museums had begun to collect photographs and exhibit them alongside paintings.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Музеи признали фотографию вопреки мнению критиков: Nevertheless (A). Accordingly — признание не следует из пренебрежения; For example и Likewise не передают «вопреки».

items.passage: The team's model accurately predicted rainfall in coastal areas. ______ its predictions for mountainous regions were often off by more than 50 percent, suggesting that the model does not adequately account for elevation.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Точно у побережья и неточно в горах — противопоставление: In contrast (B). Consequently — точность у моря не причина ошибок в горах; Similarly — противоположно; In other words — не пересказ.

items.passage: Monarch butterflies travel up to 4,000 kilometers to spend the winter in central Mexico. ______ no individual butterfly makes the round trip: the butterflies that return north in spring are the children or grandchildren of those that left.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Неожиданное уточнение к сказанному: Yet («и всё же») (B). Therefore — «никто не делает круг» не следует из длины пути; Similarly и For example не передают противопоставление.

items.passage: The poet rarely used rhyme in her early work. ______ her later poems, written after she moved to the coast, are full of rhyme and regular meter.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Ранние без рифмы, поздние с рифмой — контраст: By contrast (A). As a result — отсутствие рифмы раньше не причина рифм потом; Likewise — противоположно; In summary — не итог.

items.passage: Some historians attribute the fall of the empire to invasions from the north. Others, ______ point to decades of crop failures that weakened the economy long before the invasions began.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Другая группа историков с другим объяснением: however (C). Therefore — мнение одних не причина мнения других; likewise — сходство, а объяснения разные; that is — пересказ.

items.passage: The new vaccine was effective in laboratory tests on mice. ______ researchers caution that results in mice do not always predict how a vaccine will work in humans.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Оговорка, ограничивающая успех: Nonetheless («тем не менее») (C). Therefore — осторожность не следует из успеха; Likewise и For instance не вводят ограничение.

items.passage: The sculpture appears to be carved from a single block of marble. ______ it was assembled from seven separate pieces joined so precisely that the seams are almost invisible.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе предложение раскрывает, как на самом деле: In fact (B). Therefore — сборка не следует из видимости монолита; Similarly и For example не подходят к опровержению впечатления.

items.passage: City planners widened a highway to reduce traffic. ______ within a few years, congestion was as bad as before, because the wider road attracted more drivers.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Мера дала обратный цели эффект — Ironically (B). Accordingly означал бы ожидаемый результат; Similarly и In addition не передают противоречие цели и итога.

items.passage: Neanderthals were once portrayed as brutish and simple. ______ archaeological evidence shows that they made jewelry, buried their dead, and controlled fire.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Находки опровергают старое представление: However (B). Consequently — находки не следуют из представления; For instance сделал бы украшения примером «примитивности»; Similarly — противоположно.

items.passage: Spider silk is, by weight, stronger than steel. ______ it is far more elastic, stretching up to several times its original length before breaking.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Ещё одно достоинство шёлка: Moreover (B). However и Instead предполагают противопоставление или замену; Therefore — эластичность не следует из прочности.

items.passage: The ancient Greeks knew that Earth was round. ______ around 240 BCE, Eratosthenes estimated its circumference with remarkable accuracy by comparing the angles of shadows in two cities.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Второе предложение подкрепляет первое ярким примером: Indeed (C). However, Instead и Conversely вводят противоположность, которой нет.

items.passage: The startup's first product sold poorly. ______ the company used customer feedback to redesign it, and the second version became a best seller.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
items.explanation: Компания не сдалась после неудачи: Undeterred («не отступив») (B). Accordingly означал бы, что редизайн — ожидаемое следствие провала, но смысл текста — в настойчивости; Similarly и In other words не подходят.
